title: Get to know Clinic Catalog
summary: Tour of Ailments, Medications, Dental Conditions and Dental Surfaces: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Clinic Catalog
steps.details: This section has 4 screens; we'll go through them one by one.

steps.title: Ailments
steps.details: List of diagnoses and ailments chosen in the clinical history and the patient's medical background. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Medications
steps.details: Medications chosen when prescribing treatments, recording the patient's medication and writing prescriptions. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Dental Conditions
steps.details: Defines what can be marked on each tooth (cavity, filling, missing…) and how it looks on the odontogram. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Dental Surfaces
steps.details: Tooth surfaces (occlusal, mesial, distal…) on which findings and treatments are recorded. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
